comment: Model/mode templates (bytes 2-3 and 20-31) taken from real dumps. Bytes 20-29 are identical for all units of a model in the same configuration (two independent PE6000 units agree); byte 30/31 only carry the checksum. See EEPROM_MAP.md.

templates.name: PE1600
templates.notes: Exact model identity not independently confirmed.

templates.name: PE3000-A
templates.source: own dump, scale whose EEPROM could no longer be reprogrammed
templates.notes: Contents are fully valid. Differs from PE3000-B only in bytes 22, 25 (and checksum byte 30).

templates.name: PE3000-B
templates.notes: Original chip. Bytes 22/25 differ from PE3000-A by +113 / +2.

templates.name: PE6000
templates.source: own dump; independent forum PE6000 has the same bytes 20-29

templates.name: PE360
templates.notes: Different family (bytes 28-31 differ in form from the PE11..PE6000 group).
